LESSON: CARE OF THE TEETH

Grade: Grade 1
Subject: HYGIENE AND NUTRITION ACTIVITIES
Strand: Health Practices
Topic 1.2: Care of the teeth

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Care of the teeth. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN
